items.title: Investors cut tech exposure by the most since 2006: BofA survey
items.summary:
Bank of America's (BAC) Fund Managers Survey shows that net tech overweight fell from 37% to 12% — the largest monthly reduction in 20 years.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the details.
